main_body: brick kitchen range with a metal range hood, cooktop, and firebox
top_band: trapezoidal metal hood/shelf top (rows 21-26) and recessed grey metal cooktop surface with burner grates (rows 28-34)
evidence: The main range body shows a 6-row slanted/horizontal hood top (rows 21-26) with a dark front edge (row 26) and eave shadow (row 27), plus a recessed cooktop surface (rows 28-34) with a light front edge (row 34) and shadow (row 35) above the brick front face with an inset firebox (rows 36-47).

style.evidence: The bricks are solid flat-filled rectangles of a single mauve colour with no individual stone shading or speckle, the metal hood is a flat 4x26 fill of one dark grey tone, and the hood/firebox use pure near-black outlines, looking much flatter and simpler than the Beodeul stall and well references.
